wl.notifications.intro: Channels send each capture to another service. The server sends them, never your browser.
wl.notifications.limits: Up to {{max}} channels per endpoint. Test messages can be sent {{perMinute}} times a minute.
wl.notifications.suppression: Captures over a channel's hourly limit are counted and sent together in the next message, so a busy endpoint does not flood the channel.
wl.notifications.readOnly: Your role lets you see the channels. Editors can change them.
wl.notifications.unavailable: Notifications are not available on this instance.
wl.notifications.empty: No channels yet. A channel sends a message to a chat, an e-mail address or a browser each time a capture arrives.
wl.notifications.list.label: Notification channels
wl.notifications.test.suppressed: Test held back at {{time}} by the hourly limit.
wl.notifications.test.queued: Test queued at {{time}}. The result is not shown here yet.
wl.notifications.editor.name: Name
wl.notifications.editor.savedUrl: Saved as {{url}}. Type a new URL to replace it.
wl.notifications.editor.noSecrets: This endpoint has no secrets yet. Create the bot token as a secret first.
wl.notifications.editor.noVerified: No confirmed address yet. Add one below and confirm it from your e-mail.
wl.notifications.editor.perHourHint: Captures over this limit are counted and sent together in the next message.
wl.notifications.delete.title: Delete this channel?
wl.notifications.delete.body: Messages stop for this channel right away.
wl.notifications.issue.perHour: Enter a whole number of 1 or more.
wl.notifications.issue.hostNotAllowed: This host is not allowed for this kind of channel.
wl.notifications.issue.invalidFormat: The saved URL is shown masked. Type the full URL to change it.
wl.notifications.issue.notVerified: This address is not confirmed yet.
wl.notifications.error.generic: The change was not saved. Try again.
wl.notifications.error.load: Notification channels could not be loaded.
wl.notifications.error.creatorOnly: Only the creator of this channel can change it.
wl.notifications.error.rateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in {{seconds}} s.
wl.notifications.error.rateLimitedNoWait: Too many requests. Try again later.

wl.notifications.push.signIn: Sign in to send to browsers and e-mail.
wl.notifications.push.unsupported: This browser does not support browser push notifications.
wl.notifications.push.subscribed: This browser is subscribed. Save the channel to use it.
wl.notifications.push.denied: The browser blocked notifications for this site. Allow them in the browser settings and try again.
wl.notifications.push.dismissed: Notifications were not enabled. Try again.
wl.notifications.push.workerFailed: The browser could not start the notification worker for this site. Reload the page and try again.
wl.notifications.push.failed: The browser subscription failed. Try again.
wl.notifications.addresses.title: E-mail addresses
wl.notifications.addresses.intro: Only a confirmed address can receive e-mail notifications.
wl.notifications.addresses.unavailable: E-mail notifications are not available on this instance.
